messages:
miguel (infra): Heads-up: starting today were opening two new Dedicated pools — sa-east1 (Sao Paulo) and af-south1 (Cape Town). These pools expose a new instance type: A100X-80GB (multi-instance optimized). Available for Reserved contracts now; limited on-demand capacity for trials.

jean (product): Nice! Any changes to reservation minimums or billing? :money_with_wings:

miguel (infra): Yes — a couple policy notes: 1) new minimum reservation unit is 2 GPUs for A100X pools, 2) burst capacity outside committed reservations is allowed but billed at premium burst rates, 3) region-specific quotas apply for first 90 days to avoid noisy-neighbor impact.

miguel (infra): Quick CLI example to create a reservation:
```
redwood reserve create --region sa-east1 --pool dedicated --gpu a100x-80 --count 4 --start 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z --duration 30d
```

finance-bot: Note: burst rate = base committed rate * 2.4 for A100X-80 during the preview window. See billing doc: https://redwood.internal/billing/dedicated-a100x-preview (internal).

tara (sales): Will this be available to enterprise Private customers (VPC) too? Customers in LATAM have been asking.

miguel (infra): Short answer: yes. Private deployments can request on-prem equivalents via field engineering; for VPC we will offer the region pools as Dedicated endpoints (same controls). Reach out to field-eng for sizing.

jean (product): Migration guidance to avoid runtime surprises?

sre-lead: Recommended steps: 1) pin model versions in route config, 2) set a canary rollout (5% traffic) into sa-east1 first, 3) enable KV cache warmup for long-prefixed workloads. If you rely on kernel-specific quant profiles, test them in staging — A100X has slightly different kernel selection.

miguel (infra): Capacity notes: initial available capacity = ~48 GPUs in each region for new reservations, another ~12 GPUs for on-demand trial use. Were throttling new on-demand until monitoring shows stable perf. If you need >48 GPUs for a committed project, open a reservation request form and tag @miguel.

jean (product): Any constraints for Dedicated rollout (SLA changes)?

miguel (infra): No SLA change at launch. SLA for Dedicated remains the same; we will monitor latency percentiles closely and update if needed.

capacity-bot: [SYSTEM] Pools updated: sa-east1:a100x-80 (48 avail), af-south1:a100x-80 (50 avail). Quotas applied to new tenants for first 90 days.

tara (sales): Copy — I'll coordinate with LATAM AE team, pinging @jean for materials.

jean (product): I'll drop a short PRD + rollout checklist in #devex in the next 2 hours.

miguel (infra): FYI ops contact for region ramps: infra-oncall@redwood.internal; for reservation exceptions use reservations@redwood.internal. If you hit any perf regressions, please include logs + model hash + route config in ticket.

jean (product): +1. Also plan for a small post-launch sync next Friday for telemetry review.

sre-lead: Will prepare a synthetic load script and share in #eng-sre. Example perf test:
```
ab --concurrency 8 -n 1000 http://sa-east1.dedicated.redwood/v1/generate
```

miguel (infra): Thanks everyone. Expect an external announcement next week once we've validated the on-demand flow. For now, internal-only: priority reservations and field-sales customers first. :rocket:
